RemoteHint: Open this instance from any browser using its own secure address. Your PC must stay running. The invitation beta uses Cloudflare to carry the connection.
RemoteConsent: Allow remote access to this instance through Cloudflare. Authentication will remain required.
RemoteUrlQr: Open this instance on your phone
RemoteStatusRestartRequired: Your address is reserved. Restart KittyClaw once to finish activation, then refresh this page.
RemoteStatusAuthenticationRequired: Configure your authenticator before resuming Internet access.
RemoteStatusOnline: Connected to Cloudflare. Open the address on your other device and enter your authenticator code.
RemoteStatusRetrying: Connection interrupted. KittyClaw will retry automatically.
RemoteAuthenticationRequired: First configure an authenticator on this PC. It protects access from the Internet.
RemoteInvitationInvalid: The invitation was refused. Check your invitation code or contact the beta administrator.
RemoteOwnershipInvalid: This installation's remote credentials were refused. Contact the beta administrator.
RemoteIdentityMismatch: The saved installation belongs to another service or port. Restore its original configuration before retrying.
RemotePortInvalid: The remote access port configuration is invalid.
RemoteRetired: This address has been permanently retired. Contact the beta administrator.
RemoteBrokerUnavailable: The remote access service is unavailable or not deployed yet. Your local instance remains available.
RemoteBrokerInvalid: The remote access service returned an unexpected response. The connector was not started.
RemotePlatformUnsupported: The managed connector is not available for this operating system and processor yet.
RemoteBinaryInvalid: The Cloudflare connector did not pass its integrity check. It was not executed.
RemoteConnectorUnavailable: The connector could not stay connected. Check this PC's Internet connection and try again.
RemoteStatusError: Internet access needs attention. See the message below.
RemoteNameHint: For example, my-office gives my-office.kittyclaw.dev. Use 3–32 letters, digits or hyphens. Leave blank for an automatic name. The reserved address is kept when you stop or resume access. The name cannot be changed after activation.
RemoteNameInvalid: Choose a valid, available name with 3–32 letters, digits or hyphens. Service names and prefixes kc- and xn-- are reserved.
RemoteNameUnavailable: This address is already reserved or in use. Choose another name; your invitation has not been consumed.
RemoteNameLocked: This installation already has a name pending registration. Retry with the saved name; assigned addresses cannot be renamed.
